dependencyDashboardHeader:
This issue lists Renovate updates and detected dependencies. Read the [Dependency Dashboard](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/dashboard/) docs to learn more.

Entries under **Detected dependencies** marked `(pinned: ...)` are deliberately held back for this environment and are never updated.

customManagers.description: Tracked: a '# renovate:' comment on the line above a version (datasource + depName) or above a commit sha (git-refs + branch).
Pinned: a '# renovate-pinned:' comment. Listed in the dashboard's detected dependencies, never updated.

packageRules.description: GROUPING: all workflow action updates arrive as one PR.
GROUPING: the go version in the devcontainer, workflows and go.mod files moves together.
GROUPING: the node version in the devcontainer and workflows moves together.
GROUPING: k8s client libraries and controller-runtime must move together.
VERSIONS: the yolov9 export stage stays on python 3.11 (torch/onnx tooling compatibility).

OPT-IN: update is listed as pending in the dashboard, and the PR is only opened when you tick it. onnx output must load in frigate's bundled onnxruntime; the yolov9 and blueprint repos only offer commits, not releases.
PINNED: shown in the dashboard, never updated. (The datasource above only exists so the entry isn't skipped.)
